messages:
liz: Heads-up — partner QA flagged a throughput/regression on ROCm builds when running our kv-cache stress harness. Seen on their infra only so far :grimacing:
akshay: Can you drop the exact command/logs? Might be perf cliff at sequence boundary or a kernel fallback.
liz: pasted logs below from their repro run:
```
[2026-03-20T15:03:12Z] model: redwood/gpt-XX
env: rocm-5.4.0, kernel module 5.19
cmd: python run_kvcache.py --batch 8 --seq 2048 --fp16
error: latency spike at token 1024, threads spiking, >300ms/token
```
maria: thx. we saw a similar pattern on a customer repro last month on ROCm 5.3->5.4 upgrade. Looks like one of the fused attention kernels falls back to a slower path for long sequences.
kevin: quick ask — what is the partner's marketplace packaging? are they on our curated AMI or using their own driver pin? @partner-eng-jp?
partner-eng-jp: they're packaging through the cloud marketplace image with vendor-driver pin (ROCm 5.4.0) and our runtime 1.7. They ran our quickstart container but host driver is pinned by partner image.
hua: OK. two parallel tracks: 1) determine mitigation (runtime shim / kernel select patch) 2) partner-facing rollback or pin guidance. We should avoid forcing a global rollback if a targeted shim works.
akshay: I can prototype a kernel-selection guard that forces the quantized attention kernel selection for sequences >1024 to avoid fallback. low-risk change.
maria: can you also add a telemetry flag so we can verify at partner site? minimal sampling.
akshay: yes. plan: branch with guard + telemetry -> internal smoke -> partner can run a canary container. estimated turnaround 48h.
liz: partner wants a comms template we can send with instructions for a hotfix canary and an option to pin back to ROCm 5.3 if needed.
kevin: I'll draft the comms and include explicit rollback steps and marketplace image tag to revert to. Also include how to run the smoke command:
```
docker run --rm -e RW_TELEMETRY=1 redwood/inference:canary-5
python /opt/redwood/bin/run_kvcache.py --batch 2 --seq 2048
```
partner-eng-jp: we need a timeline. partner legal wants messaging cleared by EOD their timezone (JST).
hua: can we target a canary deploy to partner image tomorrow morning JST? deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy for marketplace image redwood/inference:canary-5 at 2026-03-21T00:30:00Z.
akshay: starting work now. I'll post a short patch diff in #eng-runtime when ready.
maria: QA checklist — run long-seq kv stress (seq 1024/2048), measure p50/p95, verify no token-time regressions, confirm telemetry tag visible.
liz: also add a note to partner comms about optional pin: `ROCm=5.3.x` and exact marketplace image tag for revert. Keep message friendly — they're nervous about GA.
kevin: draft ready. dropping here for quick review:
"We noticed a performance regression affecting long sequences on ROCm 5.4 when used with the marketplace image. We're rolling out a targeted canary hotfix you can run (no infra changes needed). Steps: 1) pull `redwood/inference:canary-5` 2) run smoke command above 3) share telemetry id with us. If you prefer, you can revert to the verified image `redwood/inference:prod-20260215-rocm5.3`."
liz: looks good. add contact: eng-runtime-oncall + partner-eng.
partner-eng-jp: partner confirms they'll run the canary tonight JST and share logs.
maria: once partner validates, we'll coordinate a marketplace image update and an announcement doc for partners/marketplace ops.
akshay: patch pushed to PR 4321, includes telemetry opt-in and kernel guard. CI green on unit tests, running perf smoke on internal GPU farm now.
kevin: tagging release manager @liz for gating decision.
liz: gating: if partner perf diff <5% and no error traces within 24h, approve marketplace image update. else rollback to prod-20260215-rocm5.3 and investigate.
partner-eng-jp: acknowledged. will provide status by 2026-03-21T08:00:00JST. :thumbsup: 
hua: thanks all. keep updates short in this thread so we have a single source of truth. :eyes:
deploy-bot: canary deploy completed and healthchecks passed (3/3) for redwood/inference:canary-5 :shipit:
akshay: initial perf smoke — p95 reduced from 420ms -> 180ms at seq 2048 on our internal ROCm lab. sharing numbers in #eng-runtime now.
maria: great, forwarding to partner QA.
kevin: I'll prep the marketplace release notes and partner ops playbook once partner signs off.
liz: awesome, thanks everyone. we should capture the postmortem / root cause in platform docs after closure.
